arguments.sql:
SELECT printf('%05d', ml.zip) AS zip_code, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM transactions t
JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id
WHERE ml.state = 'MA' AND ml.zip IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ml.zip
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, ml.zip
LIMIT 1
arguments.explanation: Finds the Massachusetts ZIP code with the most transactions, counted over all transactions at MA merchant locations, and returns it as a zero-padded five-digit text value.
assumptions: Counts all transactions, labelled or not, at merchant locations in state 'MA'.
Transactions at locations with a NULL ZIP are excluded.
ZIP is stored as an integer, so it is zero-padded to five digits with printf('%05d') to restore leading zeros (e.g. 02139).
Ties, if any, are broken by the smaller ZIP code.
